text:
Tarragon Tomatoes

Df2-8 ripe tomatoes - peeled
1/4 cup parsley - chopped
1 clove garlic - crushed, minced
1 tsp. salt (less?)
1/4 tsp. pepper
1 tsp. sugar
1/4 cup olive or salad oil
2 T. Tarragon vinegar
2 tsp. prepared mustard

Cut out stem and slice into 1/2 inch slices. Arrange in shallow dish.
Combine other ingredients in a jar and shake well. Pour over tomatoes. Let
stand at room temperature at least 20 minutes.
